title: Magnetic force balance
description: Essential: The student must correctly set up the force balance equation for static equilibrium: magnetic force component up the incline equals gravitational component down the incline.

title: Circuit current calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the circuit current using Ohm's law with total resistance (R1 + R2 + r) for both parts.

title: Magnetic induction magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be B = 1.2 T (or equivalent with correct units).

title: Dynamic force equation
description: Important: For part (2), the student must apply Newton's second law with net force = ma, accounting for both magnetic and gravitational components.

title: Acceleration magnitude and direction
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be a = 1.2 m/s² up the incline (or equivalent with correct sign/description).

title: Geometry of force components
description: Important: The student must correctly resolve the magnetic force (BIL) along the incline using cosθ and the gravitational component using sinθ.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student reverses the direction of magnetic or gravitational force in the equation, leading to wrong sign/acceleration.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Award if the student explicitly shows unit analysis or converts all quantities to SI units consistently.

title: Circuit resistance omission
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student omits internal resistance r or rod resistance R1 in total circuit resistance calculation.
